paths.title: Avalanche Hurler
paths.description: Treat every weapon at your belt as a missile, hurling axes and hammers with more force than their makers intended. Spending an action point lets you throw a weapon for free alongside your extra action, and your thrown weapons strike harder and keep their accuracy even at long range. With two melee weapons in hand, you shift in to strike, then carry the assault outward with ranged attacks against a second wave of targets.

paths.title: Battlefield Archer
paths.description: Keep your head and your aim steady while the battle rages, hunting several quarries at once and striking each with greater accuracy. An action point can reroll a ranged attack or damage roll instead of granting an extra action, and it leaves you harder to catch with opportunity attacks. You can join an ally's volley with a reaction shot, earn a fresh action point when you drop a foe, and finish with a daily volley that hits every quarry and topples those it misses.

paths.title: Blade Dancer
paths.description: Fight like a dancer, weaving two blades through a rhythm that turns every exchange into a performance. Landing two melee hits in a turn raises your defenses, and an action point yields a basic attack with each weapon, with Wisdom adding to the damage. You can parry an incoming attack with a weakening counter, slip past adjacent enemies to leave them off balance, and cut through three targets in one daily storm of steel as your paired-weapon mastery deepens.

paths.title: Darkstrider
paths.description: Strike from the dark as someone who has lived where daylight never reaches. You open fights with combat advantage over foes that have yet to act, and weapon attacks against them, or against creatures that cannot see you, carry extra damage driven by Wisdom. Action points wrap you in sturdier defenses, while stone-hugging stealth, a dazing ambush, and a blinding daily strike keep enemies fumbling. Eventually your blindsense lets you perceive hidden and invisible creatures nearby.

paths.title: Giantslayer
paths.description: Make the biggest enemy on the battlefield your favorite target, using speed and nerve to cut towering foes down to size. Action points bring bonuses to accuracy and defense, with the defense bonus growing against Large or larger enemies, and you wriggle free of grabs with a counterattack and a bolstered escape check. You can clamber onto a giant's back to ride it, goad it into forgetting everyone but you, and finish with a reliable strike that stuns what it would only daze in smaller creatures.

paths.title: Harrowing Swarm Archer
paths.description: Overwhelm your prey with arrows and bolts the way a wasp swarm overwhelms a victim, leaving wounds that keep hurting and no time to recover. An action point shot that hits your quarry inflicts ongoing damage, and you strike more accurately against anything already suffering from it. Wasp's Evasion halves the damage of an incoming hit, your daily volley hampers the saving throws of up to four targets, and eventually your Hunter's Quarry damage lands even when your arrow goes astray.

paths.title: Huntmaster
paths.description: Track the most fearsome beasts to their lairs and end the hunt with a spear. When you designate your quarry you can mark it as well, gaining a better chance to hit it and to follow its trail, and an action point adds extra damage to your attacks against it. Your spear pins enemies in place, can be braced against anything that rushes you for a guaranteed critical hit, and carries a daily strike that can be repeated on your next turn. In time, nothing surprises you.

paths.title: Impilturan Demonslayer
paths.description: Hunt demons with a pair of blades and a ranger's unforgiving patience. Your Hunter's Quarry deals extra damage to demons, Arcana lends you knowledge of their ways, and spending an action point rattles the defenses of every adjacent enemy, demons most of all. Your encounter attack slows or immobilizes the fiend you cut, and your daily flurry burns it with ongoing damage that spreads to its allies. Later gifts strip resistances from the demons you hurt and ward you briefly against whatever energy they throw at you.

paths.title: Lone Wolf
paths.description: Single out your quarry and make the fight a private one, pressing close with no one else at your side. While you are adjacent to the target of your Hunter's Quarry and alone with it, you strike with improved accuracy, and an action point attack that connects leaves it weakened. Your opening challenge pulls a foe to you and dazes it, Escape the Trap slips you out of a crowd, and your daily burst shoves lesser enemies aside. Eventually each hit lets you push your prey and follow.

paths.title: Pack Runner
paths.requirements: Beast Mastery class feature; beast companion (wolf)
paths.description: Hunt as part of a pack, racing beside your wolf companion to bring prey down together. Moving in tandem sharpens both your attacks, and action points let you shift before or after your extra action. You and your wolf split a target's attention in Pack Runner Assault, take on keener senses and greater speed through Wolfskin, and your daily pounce knocks an enemy down with a savage neck bite that leaves it bleeding. Later, a single command lets you and your companion shift together.

paths.title: Pathfinder
paths.description: Blaze a trail through danger with paired blades and a deeper well of endurance. Two extra healing surges keep you on your feet, and an action point grants a move action as well as the extra action. You can freeze an enemy that steps beside you, seize on an ally's action point to gain one of your own, and unleash a daily assault that marks two foes, even spending a healing surge to begin it. Your Hunter's Quarry hits eventually restore temporary hit points.

paths.title: Ruthless Punisher
paths.description: Make humanoids your specialty, turning your quarry into a target that can expect no mercy. Against a humanoid quarry you add Wisdom to damage rolls and can spend an action point to reroll an attack roll, and later the ongoing damage you inflict grows nastier and leaves humanoid foes open to you. Crippling shots slow or weaken your prey, your terrifying name saps the aim of humanoids nearby, and your daily volley drags a target around the field, bleeding it each time it resists.

paths.title: Sharpshooter
paths.description: Treat every bow and crossbow as a finely tuned instrument, with perfect aim and a quick hand. You can shoot an adjacent foe that provokes you, fire for free whenever you spend an action point, and eventually ignore the usual penalties of cover and concealment when shooting your quarry. Stab and Shoot hits an adjacent enemy and then a second one at range, Perfect Aim lines up a shot with Wisdom added to attack and damage, and your daily barrage grows more accurate and deadly with each target.

paths.title: Shinaelestran Guardian
paths.description: Guard the wilds with fey agility and a hunter's keen watch, darting through the fight to keep your prey in sight. Action points let you shift and strike more accurately, and any accuracy bonus from your ranger features also toughens your armor for a time. Eager Pursuit lets you follow a fleeing target, a burst of arcane stride teleports you out of reach and leaves you invisible, and your daily Moon Wrath blinds foes with radiance and keeps them from teleporting away.

paths.title: Snow Tiger
paths.description: Prowl the frozen wastes with paired knives and a tiger's ferocity. Daggers, katars, and kukris hit harder in your hands, an action point grants a free melee basic attack, and eventually you shrug off cold, stride across snow and ice, and gain two more healing surges. Tiger Jump drags a foe to the ground and follows with a dazing strike, Iron Resolve turns an enemy's hit into healing or a better saving throw, and your daily frenzy terrifies the survivors.

paths.title: Stormwarden
paths.description: Become the storm at the heart of the fight, wielding two blades while harm crackles around the enemies beside you. At the end of your turn an adjacent enemy takes damage as long as you can make opportunity attacks, and later two enemies take lightning damage. Action points let you teleport before or after your extra action. You sweep nearby foes back, trade defenses for accuracy in a reckless stance, and unleash a daily hurricane of steel that cuts everything around you and returns your second wind.
